rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for fruit or other food containing lots of juice.

example.english: This orange is really juicy—one bite and juice runs all over my hand.
example.traditional: 呢個橙真係多汁，食一啖都流到成手。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 caang2 zan1 hai6 do1 zap1 sik6 jat1 daam6 dou1 lau4 dou3 seng4 sau2

rows.note: Use this for gossip, news, or details that are sensational and exciting rather than merely interesting.

example.english: This news is so juicy that I immediately told all my friends.
example.traditional: 呢單新聞勁爆到我即刻同晒啲朋友講。
example.jyutping: ni1 daan1 san1 man4 ging6 baau3 dou3 ngo5 zik1 hak1 tung4 saai3 di1 pang4 jau5 gong2
